description_en: Creates a media processing pipeline for automated and batch processing of media files
description_zh: 本接口用于创建媒体处理管道，实现媒体文件的自动化和批量处理
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-pipeline --name test-pipeline --speed Standard --priority 6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipeline

parameters.help_en:
The pipeline type. Valid values:

Standard: standard pipeline.

Boost: double-speed transcoding pipeline.

NarrowBandHDV2: Narrowband HD 2.0 pipeline
parameters.help_zh:
管道类型。取值：

Standard：标准管道

Boost：倍速转码管道

NarrowBandHDV2：窄带高清2.0管道
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en: The priority, ranging from 1 to 10. Default value: 6. A larger value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 优先级，1-10，默认6。数值越大，优先级越高
parameters.name: priority
